sections.text: TerraGroup Labs keycard (Violet) (Violet) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.text:

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Laboratory security post (R23) on the second level in The Lab.

sections.heading: Behind The Lock
sections.text:
- Possible UHF RFID Reader on the server rack
- Weapon mods on the shelves in the corners
- 2x Weapon box (6x6)
- 1x Weapon box (4x4)
- Currency on the desk
- Possible MP5SD on the server rack
- Possible modded M4A1 on the ground next to the server rack
- Possible TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials spawn on the shelve to the right of the entrance
- Possible Intelligence folder spawn on the shelve to the right of the entrance
- Multiple Valuables on the shelf next to the door as well as on the table on the far left of the room
